summary: One Mission Bay, a completed 350-unit condominium development with ground-floor retail at the corner of 3rd and Channel streets.

milestones.text: Completed: developer Strada's One Mission Bay project page says "This exciting project was completed in 2018." The page is undated and gives the year only.

DBI recorded the new-construction permits for both One Mission Bay buildings (201408133766 at 110 Channel St, 152 units; 201408133775 at 1000 3rd St, 198 units) as completed. This is the permits' closure date, not an opening or completion date.

open_questions: This record was created on 2026-09-27 to host Pier & Point's own field photos. Its summary is limited to what its cited source was re-read to confirm that day; fuller details given in this record's other notes (developer, architect, unit count, year built) were left out of the summary where that source didn't state them. Not yet researched: no milestones, costs or facts.

The completion year and the permit closure are two different kinds of date, not a conflict. Strada's project page (undated) says the project was completed in 2018, which is the year shown as the status change. DBI closed both new-construction permits on Nov 20, 2020, shown separately as permit closures; DBI also shows tenant-improvement permits for the 110 Channel St ground floor in 2018. The exact completion or opening month is not sourced.
DBI files both permits under block 8715, lot 004; this record's geometry joins the retired parcel 8715007, and later permits for the two buildings use lots 006 and 007.
